name: Hydrogen
summary: Lightest element. Most abundant in the universe. Used in fuel cells and ammonia production.

name: Helium
summary: Second lightest element. Used in balloons, deep-sea diving, and cryogenics.

name: Lithium
summary: Lightest metal. Used in batteries, ceramics, and bipolar disorder medication.

name: Beryllium
summary: Strong, lightweight metal. Used in aerospace and X-ray windows.

name: Boron
summary: Essential plant nutrient. Used in glass, ceramics, and detergents.

name: Carbon
summary: Basis of all known life. Found as diamond, graphite, and graphene.

name: Nitrogen
summary: Makes up 78% of Earth's atmosphere. Essential for amino acids and DNA.

name: Oxygen
summary: Essential for respiration. Makes up 21% of atmosphere.

name: Fluorine
summary: Most electronegative element. Used in toothpaste, Teflon, and refrigerants.

name: Neon
summary: Used in neon signs. Produces reddish-orange glow in discharge tubes.

name: Sodium
summary: Essential for nerve function. Found in table salt (NaCl).

name: Magnesium
summary: Lightweight structural metal. Essential for human body. Used in fireworks.

name: Aluminum
summary: Most abundant metal in Earth's crust. Used in aircraft, cans, and foil.

name: Silicon
summary: Second most abundant in Earth's crust. Used in computer chips and solar cells.

name: Phosphorus
summary: Essential for DNA and bones. Used in fertilizers and matches.

name: Sulfur
summary: Used in sulfuric acid, rubber vulcanization, and fertilizers.

name: Chlorine
summary: Used in water purification, PVC production, and disinfectants.

name: Argon
summary: Third most abundant gas in atmosphere. Used in welding and lighting.

name: Potassium
summary: Essential for plant growth and nerve function. Found in bananas.

name: Calcium
summary: Essential for bones and teeth. Fifth most abundant in Earth's crust.

name: Iron
summary: Most used metal worldwide. Essential for hemoglobin in blood.

name: Copper
summary: Excellent conductor of electricity. Used in wiring and plumbing.

name: Zinc
summary: Used in galvanizing steel and batteries. Essential trace element.

name: Silver
summary: Best conductor of electricity. Used in jewelry and electronics.

name: Gold
summary: Precious metal. Highly resistant to corrosion. Symbol of wealth.

name: Lead
summary: Dense, soft metal. Used in batteries and radiation shielding. Toxic.

name: Uranium
summary: Radioactive element used in nuclear power. Named after planet Uranus.
